prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1357; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision. The collision involved a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has since sought medical treatment for injuries arising from the accident. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete certified copy of the policy under which the insured party is covered, including a statement of all applicable bodily injury and property damage liability limits, and confirm whether any additional coverage, umbrella policy, or excess coverage may apply.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or event data recorder information, repair estimates, and any surveillance or dashcam footage in your possession. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later proceedings.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
